orientation: outside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: nozzles point up into space; the exhaust glow overhangs above the frame (see glow.offset); the bottom 4px are the flange onto the outer wall face
notes: Scrapper Clans "Kickjet Deluxe", a hull mount (outward is up): the Kickjet bell and strapped tank plus a rusty stovepipe nozzle with its own small flame where the bracket was, a racing stripe of hazard tape round the bell and more patches; inside the Kickjet core plus a taped spare plate, a second lamp row and a rusty feed pipe. Damaged: the lower tank strap snapped and the tank sags and weeps fuel, the dent is on fire, the stovepipe is bent over and sputtering, sparks in the core. Disabled: the bell broken off its neck, the stovepipe snapped, the tank slid off and split, the core dead. THIS FILE: the OUTSIDE half (nozzles, in space against the outer wall face; its bottom 4px are the flange onto the wall). It is never destroyed, only disabled (bent, dead, fixable).
